headline: G&A rate is 8.0% above its provisional billing rate (10.80% actual vs 10.00%)

explanation.what_happened: For August 2026 the G&A indirect rate computed from the general ledger is 10.80% (pool $316,944.03 over a total cost input base of $2,934,666.94), against a provisional billing rate of 10.00%.
explanation.why_it_matters: Under the cited requirements (FAR 52.216-7; FAR 42.704), costs are billed at provisional rates and later settled at actual rates. The actual rate has been more than 2% away from the provisional rate for 4 consecutive periods, so the provisional rate no longer tracks the actual rate.
explanation.impact: Provisional 10.00% · actual 10.80% · drift +8.0% · about $23,477.34 under-billed at provisional rates for August (0.80 points x $2,934,666.94).
explanation.recommended_action: Review what moved in the G&A pool and its base since April. Consider whether a revised provisional rate should be raised with the contracting officer before the year-end settlement.
